title: Descent of the last coefficient in a triangular monic quotient
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $d,n\geq0$, $h\in k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}]$, arbitrary $p_i\in k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d+i}][Y_i]$ for $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(n+1)$, and bounds $e_i\in\mathbb N$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Assume only that $p_n$ is monic with natural degree $e_n$. Put $D=k[X_0,\ldots,X_{d-1}][1/h]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away], and let $Q$ and $Q_0$ be the quotients by the explicit equations $hT-1,p_0,\ldots,p_n$ and $hT-1,p_0,\ldots,p_{n-1}$ respectively [def-weil-pbc-triangular-field-model-equations, def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Let $\psi:D\to_k Q$ and $\psi_0:D\to_k Q_0$ agree on the base polynomial ring with its canonical quotient maps. For any function $c:(\prod_{i=0}^n\operatorname{Fin}(e_i))\to D$, if $\sum_a\psi(c(a))\prod_{i=0}^n[Y_i]^{a_i}=0$ in $Q$, then for every $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(e_n)$ one has $\sum_{a\in\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}\operatorname{Fin}(e_i)}\psi_0(c(\operatorname{snoc}(a,j)))\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}[Y_i]^{a_i}=0$ in $Q_0$. Here snoc appends the last exponent. Earlier relations need not be monic and their degrees need not equal the earlier bounds; zero h, zero bounds and n=0 are allowed.

source.place: Tag 07BV (lemma-colimit-syntomic), first assertion: successive triangular monic equations; Tag 08JZ (lemma-localize-at-element), localization presentation. The proof uses an explicit map into the last AdjoinRoot rather than a quotient isomorphism. Sources read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07BV and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JZ.

proof.text: Let Q₀ be the preceding quotient. If Q₀ is subsingleton, the assertion follows immediately. Otherwise map p_n to g in Q₀[X]; monicity and natural degree are preserved. Construct S=AdjoinRoot g. Assign every preceding variable to of g of its class in Q₀ and the last variable to root g. Evaluation at this assignment sends the localization equation and each earlier relation to zero because they are images of relations in Q₀. The last relation maps to eval₂_root g=0. Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ therefore constructs an evaluation map ev:Q→ₖS. Earlier polynomial relations are checked using hom_eval₂ and rename_rename.

The composites ev∘psi and of g∘psi₀ agree on every base polynomial by the assumed agreements and evaluation of the renamed preceding variables. IsLocalization.ringHom_ext for powers of h proves equality on D. Thus ev sends each coefficient psi(c(a)) to of g(psi₀(c(a))).

Apply ev to the vanishing full expansion. Fin.prod_univ_castSucc splits each product into its initial product and last power. Reindex the sum along Fin.snocEquiv and Fintype.sum_prod_type, and use map_sum, map_mul and sum_mul to collect the terms by last exponent. Obtain a zero linear combination of root g powers whose coefficient at j is exactly the asserted earlier expansion. Reindex the monic AdjoinRoot power basis along natDegree(g)=e_n, then apply Fintype.linearIndependent_iff to conclude every coefficient is zero. No prior independence statement is used; when e_n=0 the theorem has no j.

from.place: Triangular field model in the approximation argument: the last-variable coefficient step in successive monic division, before induction on the preceding variables.

lean.statement:
theorem triangularFieldModel_coefficient_descent
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (d n : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
    (p : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
    (e : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ)
    (hp : (p (Fin.last n)).Monic)
    (he : (p (Fin.last n)).natDegree = e (Fin.last n))
    (psi : Localization.Away h →ₐ[k]
      (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + (n + 1))) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d (n + 1) h p)))
    (hpsi : ∀ r : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k,
      psi (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away h) r) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        (MvPolynomial.rename (fun j : Fin d ↦
          (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + (n + 1)))) r))
    (psi₀ : Localization.Away h →ₐ[k]
      (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + n)) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d n h (fun i ↦ p i.castSucc))))
    (hpsi₀ : ∀ r : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k,
      psi₀ (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away h) r) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        (MvPolynomial.rename (fun j : Fin d ↦
          (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + n))) r))
    (c : (((i : Fin (n + 1)) → Fin (e i)) → Localization.Away h))
    (hc : (∑ a : ((i : Fin (n + 1)) → Fin (e i)),
        psi (c a) * (∏ i : Fin (n + 1),
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X
            (⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + (n + 1))))) ^ (a i).val)) = 0)
    (j : Fin (e (Fin.last n))) :
    (∑ a : ((i : Fin n) → Fin (e i.castSucc)),
      psi₀ (c (Fin.snoc a j)) * (∏ i : Fin n,
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X
          (⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + n)))) ^ (a i).val)) = 0
